Which statement describes the properties of hydrochloric acid?
A
Carbon dioxide is produced when limestone reacts with hydrochloric acid.
B
Hydrogen is produced when sodium hydroxide reacts with hydrochloric acid.
C
Methyl orange turns yellow in strong hydrochloric acid.
D
Red litmus paper turns blue when dipped into hydrochloric acid.

options.label: A
options.text: Carbon dioxide is produced when limestone reacts with hydrochloric acid.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrogen is produced when sodium hydroxide reacts with hydrochloric acid.

options.label: C
options.text: Methyl orange turns yellow in strong hydrochloric acid.

options.label: D
options.text: Red litmus paper turns blue when dipped into hydrochloric acid.
